aPlusContent.rawText:
From the Publisher
Scenes from Cozy Christmas Nooks 
A Peaceful Reading Nook 
Curl up in a comfy chair with the glow of the Christmas tree, a good book, and a warm candle nearby. 
Warmth by the Fire 
Enjoy the simple joys of Christmas—soft stockings, a crackling fire, and a cozy pet curled at your feet. 
Welcoming Holiday Entryway 
A festive wreath, snowy boots, and holiday cheer greet you and your loved ones at the door. 
A Cozy Winter Retreat 
Drift into holiday dreams surrounded by twinkling lights, warm quilts, and the magic of snowfall. 
Cozy Christmas Nooks invites you to slow down, relax, and enjoy the warmth of the holiday season. With charming scenes to color and inspiring festive spaces, this book is perfect for creating a little peace and joy during Christmas time.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Fun and Relaxing Holiday Coloring Book
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I ordered this coloring book for my 6-year-old daughter, and she really enjoyed it. The pictures are cute and festive without being too complicated, so they’re fun and relaxing to color. She especially liked that there were lots of different cozy Christmas scenes to choose from. The pages are single-sided, which is nice because it keeps markers from bleeding through. Overall, it’s a great holiday-themed coloring book that made for a simple but fun activity.  We would definitely order again!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: High quality, great value, and perfect for holiday relaxation!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I was really impressed with this coloring book. You get a lot of beautiful pages for the price, and the designs perfectly capture that cozy Christmas feeling. raw_products.bookDescription:
Every season has its magic. Every creature has its celebration.
A Quiet Life in the Woods returns for its most enchanting chapter yet — a journey through all four seasons in the company of ten beloved woodland characters, each with their own special celebration to share.
From the warmth of a hedgehog family gathered around their Christmas tree in matching scarves and mugs of hot chocolate, to a fox heading out at dawn on her greatest autumn harvest day, to a rabbit dancing through the first wildflowers of spring — every page is a celebration of the simple, seasonal magic that makes life beautiful.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great for unwinding, really cosy vibeGreat for unwinding, really cosy vibe
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Picked this up recently and I’ve been using it most evenings to relax. The illustrations are really charming and have that cosy, cottagecore feel without being overly busy or complicated.There’s a good mix of seasonal scenes, so it doesn’t feel repetitive, and each page has its own little character. I like that you can finish a page in one sitting or take your time with it.Paper quality is solid for coloured pencils and I haven’t had any issues so far. Overall, it’s a simple, calming colouring book that does exactly what you want it to - help you switch off for a bit. Would happily buy another like this.

raw_products.bookDescription:
Step into the magic of Christmas with Cottage Dreams: Christmas Edition – a heartwarming festive colouring book designed to bring comfort, calm, and creativity to your winter days.
From the creators of Cottage Dreams: Summer Edition and Cottage Dreams: Autumn Edition, this cosy Christmas chapter of the beloved series invites you to wander through snow-topped cottages, twinkling village streets, and rustic festive interiors filled with candles, stockings, and winter cheer. Each of the 40 unique illustrations is lovingly designed in a bold and easy cottagecore style, perfect for both beginner and experienced colourists alike.
Inside you’ll discover:• 40 detailed yet easy-to-colour Christmas cottagecore scenes• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through• High-quality paper suitable for pencils, markers, or gel pens• A relaxing mix of indoor and outdoor festive moments – from decorating the tree and wrapping gifts by the fire to snowy walks through the countryside• A special test page to experiment with colours before you begin
Whether you’re curling up with a hot chocolate, unwinding after a busy shopping day, or gifting a loved one a creative way to relax, Cottage Dreams: Christmas Edition is the perfect companion for a slow, mindful December.
Celebrate the beauty of simple living, cosy cottages, and Christmas charm — one page at a time.
Book Details:Size: 8.5 x 8.5 inchesPages: 40 unique designs printed on single sidesPaper: High-quality white paper
About Cosy Colour Cottage:At Cosy Colour Cottage, we believe every colouring session should feel like a warm hug and a cup of tea on a chilly afternoon. Based in Norfolk, England, our small independent brand creates beautifully designed colouring books inspired by the charm of British cottage life. Each book is thoughtfully illustrated to help you slow down, unwind, and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of cosy living — one page at a time.
